title: Agenc Protocol: initialise the coordination config
summary: Initialise the Agenc protocol config. register_agent and create_task are paused on this production build until stamp_release_surface.
what: Agenc Protocol is a large Anchor 0.32 agent-coordination program (tasks, bids, disputes, skills, listings). This lesson covers only initialize_protocol, which writes a singleton config PDA after proving the caller is the upgrade authority and a second multisig owner has co-signed. The hosted IDL is a minimal hand-derived subset confirmed by the live transaction.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agenc-protocol/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in. register_agent and create_task are listed but will fail with ProtocolPaused until stamp_release_surface.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agenc-protocol/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. initialize_protocol is already done on this lab deployment.
try_steps.see: Program 2wAW3Ack… . Fetch the config PDA (seeds ["protocol"]) at BhScAVMz….

try_steps.do: A fresh initialize with dispute_threshold=0 should fail; a second initialize of this deployment should also fail because the config PDA already exists.
